node.title: F2 fixed-weight flatness to full-cube mass bridge
node.statement: For any finite-field linear syndrome map, fixed-weight mean-plus-one bounds M_b <= L(1+binom(S,b)/Q) on weights G imply the exact full-cube weighted-mass bound Z <= 3*T_G^2/2^S + 3L(S+1+2^S/Q), with the sharper factor 2 when all weights are covered. Complementation identifies weights b and S-b. Hence subexponential fixed-weight flatness on a central band with tails at most 2^(S/2+o(S)) pays the full-cube mass. No such flatness estimate or upstream owner transport is claimed.
